title: What's New (v4.4.2)
summary: Google sign-in backup behavior is more reliable after reinstall or reset, backup continuity is stronger, and onboarding restore messaging is clearer.
highlights: Google sign-in backup now behaves more reliably after reinstall or app data reset

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Google sign-in backup now behaves more reliably after reinstall or app data reset
- Improved backup continuity so your account is less likely to show a false no-backup-found message
- Backup and restore messaging is clearer during onboarding

## Improvements

- General stability and polish improvements

## Why this matters

What's New (v4.4.2) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Google sign-in backup now behaves more reliably after reinstall or app data reset gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved backup continuity so your account is less likely to show a false no-backup-found message gets a little more room to breathe.
- Backup and restore messaging is clearer during onboarding gets a little more room to breathe.
- General stability and polish improvements gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
